title: SDK-first micro-tile onboarding: streaming timelines + toolcall handshake overlays
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact set of SDK-first onboarding micro-tiles and annotated screenshots to be used across the API/SDK quickstart docs. Assets should cover: 1) credential creation and safe key usage (compact card + step overlay), 2) streaming response timeline with latency callouts and retry fallback state, and 3) tool-calling handshake diagram showing function signature exchange, example request/response, and recommended error states. Deliver both static PNG screenshots for docs and source Figma components for future iterations.
acceptance_criteria: Three unique micro-tile compositions exported at 2x and 3x for mobile and desktop
One streaming timeline visual with labeled latency bands (cold, warm, hot) and a fallback state illustration
Toolcall handshake overlay with minimal text, clear callouts for developer, runtime, and tool (iconography + microcopy)
Figma file with components, variants, tokens and a short usage guide (1 page) linked from docs
Exported PNG/JPEG assets added to Drive folder and referenced in the quickstart markdown PR
